text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Benissimo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (It's beyond my imagination...!! The emotion enveloping my entire being...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(That wonderful time when the melodies
of our souls clashed...!!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (So this... this is what a once-in-a-lifetime live session feels like...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I want to embrace the world right now...!!
With all my passion...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Still... I can't let myself be satisfied with just this!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(I must strive for it...!
To become a truly magnificent performer...!!)
As I waited to welcome Sounds of Earth after her debut race—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ――Direttore!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ――Direttrice!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Did you listen closely
to our performance today...?!
choice_data_list: That was the best debut race ever!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie...!
Grazie mille!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"……I've come to understand it once more.
The passion that dwells within a real race――"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The one-and-only harmony woven
by a fleeting, once-in-a-lifetime sequence of moments!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I want to feel this music even more...!!
I want to become one with it...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"To achieve that, I must sharpen it even further!
My running...!! More, even more...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "Guide me, Direttore!! To the stage of the ultimate session!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "Guide me, Direttrice!! To the stage of the ultimate session!"

I returned to the waiting room with Sounds of Earth,
who was still buzzing with excitement—
choice_data_list: I'd like to propose a new direction for us going forward.

text_block_list.text:
Watching today's debut race convinced me.
Sounds of Earth truly has the potential
to reach the highest peaks.
"That is precisely why I will courageously proclaim the name of the stage we will aim for together from here on out...!"
choice_data_list: —Let's aim for the Classic races together.

text_block_list.text: —The Classic races. A battlefield steeped in tradition and glory, where only the top-class Classic-tier Umamusume are permitted to run.

The 'ultimate stage' that so many Umamusume long for...
And among them, there's one race in particular I want to aim for with Sounds of Earth...!

"The 'greatest race' known to all,
where the 'greatest Umamusume' who define their generation gather—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Bravissimo!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you are just... just too much...!!
How cruel of you!! Thanks to you, I've—
No sooner had he said that than Sounds of Earth closed the distance between us in a flash...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
âListen... Can't you hear it?
My surging, racing heartbeat.
Hearing her whisper that right in my ear made my own heart beat wildly instead...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —You really believe in me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That I am the player who can reach *there*...!

...Of course, it will by no means be an easy path.
It is the royal road of the chosen, aiming for the pinnacle of their generation.
And yet—
—Asking to be guided to the greatest stage.
I believe with all my heart that Sounds of Earth can reach the pinnacle of stages.

No, before anything else, above all...
I want to see her running happily
in the Japanese Derby too...!
Those feelings transformed into the sound of her running, overflowing from within her...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Aah—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...I must answer it.
This powerful trust echoing from you...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let's aim for it, Trainer.
For the Classic races. For the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "From this very moment, a new movement begins...!!"

"...With her debut race safely behind us,
we decided to aim for the Classic races with Sounds of Earth—"
A few days later—

I was having a meeting with Sounds of Earth
to decide specifically how we would
navigate her Junior Class year.
choice_data_list: —Let's focus purely on building your fundamentals during the Junior Class.

text_block_list.text:
For that purpose, during the Junior Class, we didn't set specific
target races, instead adopting a flexible approach to enter races
while closely observing her growth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: So instead of an actual live session, you're placing priority on the *pratica*—on training, I take it?

I nod in agreement. I plan to stick
with this approach right up until just before
the spring of her Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The spring of the Classic year, huh—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
In that case, though...
What do you intend to do about the Satsuki Sho?

The Satsuki Sho is one of the Classic races,
and together with the Japan Derby and the Kikuka Sho,
they are collectively known as the "Classic Triple Crown."

This GⅠ race held at Nakayama Racecourse
is the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown,
and while it is indeed the pinnacle stage—
choice_data_list: I think I'd rather prioritize building up my skills.

text_block_list.text: "Rather than adjusting my conditioning for the Satsuki Sho, I intended to set my sights on the Japanese Derby and take the time to properly condition myself."
"You see, after all, the Nippon Derby is special among the Triple Crown—the race one wants to win above all else—"

Because it is the supreme festival for every Umamusume,
Trainer, and racing fan alike.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Slow and steady without rushing, huh? Sounds good.
A grand journey ought to be that way!

Of course, if her ability is already polished enough
to compete in the Satsuki Sho,
we might want to consider entering her.
Either way, what I want to cherish is—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—That's right!
Yes, what matters most is the feeling of enjoying it...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Let's enjoy it and give it our all. For the etude ahead!!
—And so, with our future plans decided, our Junior Class campaign kicked off in earnest!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Oops.
Is it that time already?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(It's no good having too many sounds overflow either.
I just get so absorbed in transcribing them into melodies—)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Or perhaps, "PREV"—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...A small "entropy"... I felt it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Universe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(—Neo Universe-san.
An Umamusume echoing with a mysterious, quiet sound, reminiscent of a vast starry sky...)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Somehow... in the sound she plays,
I feel a destined sense of comfort—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Buonasera, Universe-san.
It's a pleasant night where the stars feel so close.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative.
"COMF"――――calming.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ......Neo Universe will ask a "question".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Sounds of Earth is 'approaching.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――"PONR"... "Fork in the Road."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Moving forward is "distortion"—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Connecting 'differences'...
That means 'creating' 'ABST'."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Even so... will you advance to the next phase?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
……Your words are always so beautiful.
They feel almost like glad tidings from a being beyond human comprehension.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"You are probably worried about me, aren't you?
Grieving for the journey that lies ahead—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Not through words, but through your tone, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie, Miss Universe.
However, I have no intention of stopping.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...No—
I can't stop...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's overflowing...!
The sound is right here...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: As long as I have this passion, I will move forward! And no matter what happens—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Because that, too, will become
irreplaceable music to me...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
————"UNDY."
...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Then... Neo Universe will "watch over" it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (What the?! All of a sudden, a light—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
A truly mysterious person, indeed.
"...Under the star-studded night sky, Sounds of Earth's strides were about to resonate throughout the world—"
